findings.ac: Exactly one module declares either canonical set (invariant 1)
findings.text: The grep-style test 'declares the canonical job-function set in exactly one module' keys only on the literals 'business_ops' and 'regulatory', so it covers job functions only. Nothing asserts single declaration of CANONICAL_SECTORS, and the snapshot still holds other sector-key lists (src/lib/constants.js SECTORS, api/submit.js SECTORS superset, the api/enrich.js prompt) that no test would flag or sanction.

findings.ac: workflow_dispatch dry_run:true performs no database writes
findings.text: BT169_DryRun.test.js asserts client.writes is empty, but its recording client returns [] for every select. The !dryRun guard around reconcileCompanyJobDelta in runAtsIngestionBatch (the archiving writes) and the runLifecycle && !dryRun guard would never produce a write even if removed, so a regression in those two guards would not fail the test. Only touchCompanyLastChecked and the final upsert suppression are genuinely exercised.

findings.ac: Verification: no assertion anywhere asserts a legacy job-function value
findings.text: No automated check enforces this. src/pages/JobView.test.jsx still carries job_function: 'engineering' and funcOpts { 'engineering': ... } fixtures, left unchanged by the slice. The BT164_StuttgartShootoutIngest test also feeds legacy slugs as inputs (not as asserted outputs).

findings.ac: Stress Cases: unclassifiable role ingested with job_function absent rather than failing its batch
findings.text: Only buildJobRows is tested (job_function 'general' gives a null row). No test runs an unclassifiable candidate through upsertJobCandidates or runAtsIngestionBatch to show the batch still succeeds, and the row's status is not asserted. calculateConfidenceScore still adds 7 points for a raw, non-canonical job_function before normalization.
